items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey, listed questionable (hamstring) vs. Jaguars, is unlikely to play per source.
items.implication: Elevates other Broncos RBs (JK Dobbins contingency) in run game.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved steadily; team did not elevate WR, pushing to play with optimism barring setback. Schefter adds flak jacket expected if active.
items.why: Steady improvement, no elevation, flak jacket prep.
items.implication: If active, full-ish role vs. LV; if out, QJ/Harris explode.
items.opportunity: Maintains high target share; contingency volume to Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave, listed questionable (hamstring) at Baltimore, is expected to play. Rapoport corroborates with Chase Young also expected.
items.implication: Full WR1 role for Olave in tough road matchup; Kamara also returning.

items.text: Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick with Brock Bowers doubtful (knee/meniscus); Bowers practiced Friday but unlikely Week 2, optimistic for Week 3.
items.why: Meniscus cleanup; pregame workout possible but elevation signals low expectation.
items.implication: Michael Mayer remains TE1 with full opportunity; Jeanty usage already strong.
items.opportunity: Full TE routes/targets for Mayer; continued RB pass-game for Jeanty.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs. Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Removes top WR; elevates Andrews/Likely and remaining Ravens pass-catchers in favorable home spot.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Mark Andrews and secondary WRs.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs. Patriots due to foot injury.
items.implication: Opens targets in PIT passing game; DK Metcalf and others rise.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/target share for remaining Steelers WRs.

items.text: Texans ruled WR Nico Collins OUT for Week 2 vs. Bengals with hamstring injury suffered in Wednesday practice; not believed serious but misses this week.
items.implication: Major volume redistribution in Texans WR/TE room vs. CIN.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for Dalton Schultz, Kayshon Boutte, Xavier Hutchinson.

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin, Q for MNF vs. Giants) a pre-game decision; Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: No practice multiple days; different injury from camp; MNF timing.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out, TEs (Ferguson/Parkinson) and Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields rise. Berry notes same.
items.opportunity: If active high-end WR1; if out heavy TE/WR2-3 bump.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play vs. Texans.
items.why: Coach/Taylor comments + elevation as precaution; Sunday reports good to go barring setback.
items.implication: Full Burrow stack viable with Chase/Higgins vs. HOU missing Collins.

items.text: Cheap WR Volume: Quentin Johnston ($5k DK) and Tre Harris project 5+ targets regardless, but large roles/22% shares if McConkey out vs. Raiders; McConkey Q status key.
items.why: Week 1 shares after McConkey limited routes; friendly matchup.
items.implication: Strong DFS/flex pivots if McConkey sits; still playable if he plays limited.
items.opportunity: 5+ target projections; expanded routes if absence.
items.conflict: McConkey now lean active reduces pure contingency but QJ still viable.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs. IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% route targets tying team lead; IND just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization + soft run matchup.
items.implication: RB1 upside; start with confidence as high as RB4 overall lean.

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score (tied Bijan league lead), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite utilization and passing-game involvement; soft LAC defense.
items.implication: RB1/2 range; Bowers absence further boosts.

items.text: Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18.0 PPG career with Wentz; Bears soft vs. WRs last week.
Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1; 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further as underdogs.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return + poor script.
items.implication: Fade or sit; Kamara preferred if active.
items.opportunity: Negative for Etienne volume; positive for Kamara touches.

items.text: Updated Week 2 tiers: Michael Mayer TE10 rocket with Bowers doubtful; also notes Puka WR3/Ladd WR22 injury flags.
items.why: Bowers absence elevates Mayer into startable TE range.
items.implication: Start Mayer as TE1 this week.

items.text: Loves Bucky Irving vs. CLE: RB9 utilization, 26% target share, every RB red-zone touch; CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
Loves Dak Prescott vs. WAS: 21.3 PPG home last year; WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Week 1; top-5 implied total in high-total game.
items.why: Smash spot vs. weak secondary + high total.

items.text: Loves Dalton Kincaid vs. DET (top-5 TE util, 69% routes higher than any 2025 game; DET allowed 27 to TEs) and Mike Evans vs. MIA (WR14 util, 25% RZ share, soft secondary).
